summary: The compact layout adapts well to the 320px viewport, but displays series differentiation issues in the trend chart and contrast problems within the material token preview.

issues.title: Indistinguishable multi-series styles
issues.description: Plays and Downloads share identical solid grey strokes and legend markers, making data series impossible to distinguish.
issues.evidence: Both legend indicators are solid grey squares corresponding to identical solid grey chart lines.
issues.suggestion: Use distinct stroke styles (such as dashed vs. solid) or differentiated tonal shades for each data series.

issues.title: Low contrast specimen text
issues.description: Specimen preview labels behind the translucent material pills suffer from poor legibility.
issues.evidence: Light grey specimen labels inside the glass stack preview blend into the white frosted overlays.
issues.suggestion: Darken specimen text or adjust layer opacity to ensure adequate contrast.
